Generate events from hydrolocations (data.table + sf nearest-feature, GEOS)

Source: R/events.R
rf_generate_events_from_hydrolocations_fast.Rd

Reads only the necessary layers and uses vectorized nearest-feature queries to snap hydrolocations onto reference flowpaths and emit split events. This is the sole event-generation entry point used by the refactor phase.

Usage

rf_generate_events_from_hydrolocations_fast(
  hydrolocations_gpkg,
  flowpaths_gpkg = NULL,
  hydroloc_layer = NULL,
  flowpath_layer = "reference_flowpaths",
  out_gpkg = NULL,
  force_lr = TRUE,
  tolerance_m = 50,
  collapse_threshold_m = 250,
  min_area_m = 0,
  snap_threshold_m = 250
)

Arguments

hydrolocations_gpkg

Path to the GeoPackage of hydrolocations (POIs) to snap onto flowpaths.

flowpaths_gpkg

Optional path to the reference flowpaths GeoPackage; defaults to hydrolocations_gpkg when NULL.

hydroloc_layer

Hydrolocations layer name; auto-detected when NULL.

flowpath_layer

Reference flowpaths layer name. Default "reference_flowpaths".

out_gpkg

Optional output path; when NULL the events sf is returned instead of written.

force_lr

Logical; request left/right bank attribution where available. Default TRUE.

tolerance_m

numeric (meters). Maximum distance from a flowpath for a hydrolocation to match; farther candidates are dropped. Default 50.

collapse_threshold_m

numeric (meters). An event whose split would leave a piece shorter than this collapses onto the nearest flowpath endpoint. Default 250.

min_area_m

numeric. Minimum drainage-area filter for events; 0 disables it (default).

snap_threshold_m

numeric (meters). Distance within which an event snaps to a flowpath outlet/inlet node. Default 250.

Value

An sf of events; when out_gpkg is supplied it is written there and returned invisibly.
